# Project Instructions

- [x] Requirements clarified: a bright sage-green business website for Mary Sherman, using Shermanator LLC as a working name.
- [x] Project scaffolded in the existing workspace with Vite, vanilla JavaScript, and Cloudflare Workers static assets.
- [x] Responsive website customized using the user-provided professional summary.
- [x] No editor extensions required.
- [x] Dependencies installed and production build verified.
- [ ] Local development task created and launched.
- [x] Documentation completed with Cloudflare deployment instructions.

Use npm and keep this a lightweight single-page website. Use lucide for icons.
Do not invent professional credentials, testimonials, a legal registration, or contact details.
The contact form prepares a draft; it does not send or store submissions.
The optional public contact email comes from the CONTACT_EMAIL Worker variable.
Keep secrets out of frontend files and source control.
Run npm test and npm run build after changes to the relevant code.
